services.name: Current Exhibits
services.desc: Explore the grand history and domestic life of the Langdon Mansion in Elmira, New York. This exhibition tells the story of the home of one of Elmira’s most prominent and historically significant families, through the architecture, interiors, and furnishings of the now-lost dwelling. For more than seventy years, the citizens of Elmira regarded the Langdon Mansion as one of the city’s grandest houses. Not only was it an important local architectural landmark, it was also the home of the family of Olivia Langdon Clemens, the wife of Samuel L. Clemens, popularly known as Mark Twain.
